renderSaveFolderStatus.text: Assets are saved locally to your selected project folder.

renderSaveFolderNotLinked.text: When not linked, assets are stored in temporary memory only.

scanRefreshButton.text: Forces a re-scan of the project folder.

settingsSaveFolder.title: Unified Storage Link
settingsSaveFolder.text: The Unified Storage Link connects all studios to a single project directory on your local machine.

generateActorButton.text: Generates a new actor based on your prompt and selected studio style.

studioStyleSelector.text: Defines the global visual aesthetic for character generation.

addToLibraryButton.text: Saves the actor using a collision-safe filename with metadata stored separately.

actorNameDisplay.text: File names are generic. Display names are stored in metadata.

sendToDirectorButton.text: Locks this actor’s identity for downstream stages.

cameraToggle.text: Enables live capture for biometric acquisition.

captureProgressIndicator.text: All three angles improve facial stability and accuracy.

uploadToggle.text: Uploading high-resolution photos yields higher quality results than webcam frames.

identityLockSlider.text: Higher values increase facial accuracy but reduce stylization flexibility.

saveCharacterButton.text: Finalizes identity blending and saves the character to the library.

generateOutfitButton.text: Generates a clothing asset on a neutral studio background.

saveToWardrobeButton.text: Saves this item for use in Virtual Try-On.

tryOnExecuteButton.text: Single-subject enforcement prevents mannequins or floating heads.

fittingNotesInput.text: Add contextual instructions such as wear, damage, or fit.

saveProcessedImage.text: Save the current fitted render before clearing the workspace.

savePropButton.text: Saved props are available in the Stage.

stageInstructions.text: Drag and drop subjects or click to define scene structure.

dragToken.text: Use for exploratory layout and composition.

zDepthControl.text: Controls narrative priority, not physical depth.

actorNameField.text: Naming actors allows the AI to bind instructions to the correct face.

directorsNote.text: Text instructions override canvas placement when using Precision Directing.

renderButton.text: Generates a single cinematic frame from the current stage.

anchorDNAToggle.text: Locks lighting and style references, not pose or camera position.

libraryView.text: Displays assets detected in the linked project folder.

missingAssetIndicator.text: Asset may be missing or renamed externally.
